questions.q: What are the three categories of willpower McGonigal describes?
a: I won't power, I will power, I want power
questions.why: She lists the three powers as I won't, I will, I want.

questions.q: Which type of willpower is used when refusing a cookie at a meeting?
questions.why: Resisting temptation is described as I won't power.

questions.q: What biological response boosts willpower during a challenge?
questions.why: McGonigal calls the pause-and-plan response a willpower boost.

questions.q: Why is rewarding yourself with a beer after a week of sobriety considered harmful?
a: It reinforces the bad habit despite prior success
It breaks the streak and encourages relapse
It signals that good behavior excuses bad
questions.why: The text says rewarding with a beer after good behavior is the worst thing.

questions.q: What question does McGonigal suggest to identify the habit harming you most?
a: Which habit hurts health, happiness, and career the most?
What temptation do you face daily?
How often do you use I will power?
